items.raw_excerpt: A startup has developed a blight-tolerant American chestnut tree without using genetic engineering, offering new hope for restoring the once-dominant species.
items.summary_en: A startup in Portugal has created a blight-tolerant American chestnut tree without using genetic engineering. This new breeding method offers hope for restoring the once-dominant species across forests.

items.raw_excerpt: Delhi Police clarifies no ban on app-based food delivery, dismissing social media rumors as misleading amid travel advisories.

items.raw_excerpt: The Cantanhede Municipal Civil Protection Service destroyed 793 Asian hornet (Vespa velutina) nests in 2025 and has already eliminated 163 nests, both primary and secondary, between January and June of this year, it was revealed.
items.summary_en: The Cantanhede Municipal Civil Protection Service destroyed 793 Asian hornet nests in 2025. So far this year, they have already eliminated 163 nests. The campaign targets invasive hornets threatening local bee populations and crops.

items.raw_excerpt: Sheep meat linked to a farm in Yunlin County was found during a recent safety inspection to contain excessive levels of dioxins but did not enter the market, the Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA) said Saturday.
items.summary_en: A safety inspection found high dioxin levels in sheep meat from a farm in Yunlin County, Taiwan. The Taiwan Food and Drug Administration said the meat did not enter the market. The case is under investigation to ensure food safety.

items.raw_excerpt: “Neighbourhood barbershops and salons are becoming places only for people who are too lazy to wash their own hair or who have certain physical limitations. For example, they may have just undergone eye surgery,” 53-year-old hairdresser Nong says with a laugh.
items.summary_en: Local barbershops in Bangkok are losing customers as more people wash and style their hair at home.
